text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Automated alert: elevated 5xx rate observed in inference-prod (us-east-1). Threshold breach at 1776001122. Paging on-call Simon.

Simon: ack. I'm on it — checking p50/p95, error codes, and recent deploy history. Will report back in ~3m.

Ryan: heads-up to infra and vendor teams. @cloud-support please open an escalation with the cloud provider NOC; symptoms look like intermittent egress failures impacting our KV layer and model pulls.

cloud-support: acknowledged. Escalation created: CLOUD-PRD-78910. Severity P1. Providing correlation IDs and trace spans to vendor now.

Kendall: Simon, do we have a dominant error class? 502s, 504s, or TCP resets?

Simon: mostly 502s with intermittent `ECONNRESET` at the proxy -> kv-store hop. KV GET latencies jumping from 10ms to 500ms+. Capturing strace and tcpdump on the hit proxy pods.

Infra-bot: launched debug bundle job dbg-1776001122 to gather hot threads, kernel network stats, and KV metrics. Artifacts will land at s3://redwood-incidents/1776001122/.

Ryan: Maria, please draft a short status page blurb and a priority customer email. Use the usual incident template: impact, scope, mitigation steps, ETA for next update.

Maria: drafting. Suggested status page copy:
"Summary: We are investigating intermittent 5xx errors and elevated latency for inference requests in us-east-1. Scope: subset of hosted API and Dedicated pools in the region. Impact: some requests may fail or time out. What were doing: engaging cloud provider and routing around affected hosts. Next update in 20 minutes or sooner."

Customer-success: creating personalized customer message for impacted Dedicated tenants.

Elaine: add Dedicated account list to the vendor ticket so they can prioritize those customers. I'll DM the list to cloud-support.

cloud-support: added account list to CLOUD-PRD-78910. Vendor asked for packet captures and control-plane logs; attaching dbg-1776001122 now.

Kendall: mitigation proposal: (1) shift a small percentage of traffic (canary) to us-west-2 for sensitive routes, (2) enable short-term retry/backoff on modelfetch calls, (3) promote a KV replica in a healthy AZ as fallback. Recommend starting with a 5-10% canary.

Simon: approve 5% canary to start plus increased retries. Keep monitoring window tight.

Infra-bot: applied route change rule canary-shift-1776001122: 5% of eligible traffic redirected to us-west-2. Change id route-9b2.

Simon: seeing preliminary reduction in error rate from 12% to ~7% after canary. Still not fully healthy.

cloud-support: vendor response: "We detected a control-plane route update impacting egress paths for cluster group B in us-east-1. Rolling back the change and validating connectivity. Estimated validation time ~15 minutes. Reference VEND-13002." Vendor requests we refrain from external traffic shifts until they finish rollback.

Maria: updating status page: "Vendor rollback in progress; validation underway. Next update in 15 minutes." Also prepping customer email to go out in 10 minutes.

Ryan: send the customer notification to Priority customers only. Use the short template and link to status page. Approved?

Maria: approved. Sending now. Include contact for bridge requests and note Dedicated customers have priority support.

Product-bot: logged incident INC-2026-03110-02 and attached dbg bundle. Timeline entry created.

Simon: post-rollback checks: path stabilization is improving, KV GET tail latencies dropping. Error rate trending down to ~3.5% over 5m window. Keeping monitoring for 20 minutes before declaring mitigated.

cloud-support: vendor reports rollback complete and path metrics improving. Vendor will continue validation and provide formal RCA within 48 hours. VEND-13002 will include packet captures and control-plane change id.

Kendall: prepping postmortem checklist and owner assignments: incident timeline, vendor ticket ids CLOUD-PRD-78910 / VEND-13002, routing change route-9b2, debug bundle dbg-1776001122, customer notices sent. I'll draft the postmortem.

Maria: drafting follow-up message for customers to send when we mark mitigated:
"Update: The incident has been mitigated. Root cause: an upstream network configuration change by our cloud provider that caused intermittent egress packet loss affecting KV calls. We performed a partial traffic shift during mitigation while the vendor rolled back the change. We will publish a full post-incident report once vendor RCA is available."

Simon: marking incident as mitigated at 1776004722. Continuing passive monitoring for the next 24h. Please only open bridges for critical customers.

Ryan: thanks everyone. I'll track vendor credit/compensation discussion and coordinate the post-incident meeting with the vendor.

cloud-support: vendor committed to an RCA and follow-up meeting within 48 hours. Ticket updated with action items.

Kendall: handoff note for Aisha (next on-call): incident mitigated, monitor error rate and alerts for 24 hours, postmortem draft assigned to Kendall, vendor RCA pending (CLOUD-PRD-78910). Dedicated customers notified.

Aisha: ack'd and taking the monitoring window. Thanks all :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: INC-2026-03110-02 marked MITIGATED by Simon at 1776004722 :white_check_mark:
